§6Firebox & Heating Oven§f

§aBurn stuff, make heat. Two tiers of the same idea.§f

§6Firebox§f: Burns fuel slowly and efficiently. Safe for standard stirling engines (under 300 TU/t). Crafted at a Tier 2 anvil from a furnace, steel plates, and red copper.

§6Heating Oven§f: 5x the heat output, 8x faster, but burns through fuel quicker. Base output of 500 TU/t will overspeed a standard stirling, so pair it with the heavy stirling instead. Can receive heat from below (halved), so stack a few for crucible-level temperatures.

Both save fuel when the heat buffer is full.

§6Fuel bonuses§f:
§b• Coal/Lignite/Coke§f: +25% time, +100% heat
§b• Solid Fuel§f: +50% time, +200% heat
§b• Rocket Fuel§f: +50% time, +400% heat
§b• Balefire§f: -50% time, +1400% heat

§ePS:§f Firebox for stirling engines, heating oven for crucibles. Simple rule.
